question: In a certain code language, 'INSPIRE' is written as 'JPTTJZF'. How will 'FORGIVE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'INSPIRE' is written as 'JPTTJZF'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49c5baa97b405f2c9f5a78cae8c81b1cea735173987fc7594c6d1c3ba33548ee.png] 

Similarly,

'FORGIVE' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ffe3aa1d1a407665a1be5030e77dd4ec640528be7b4a548be093047e949591c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"GQSKJDF".**
